AccountRegistry.title: AccountRegistry
AccountRegistry.description: Lightweight hybrid citizen metadata and module usage summary (~0.5-1 KB per account).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID owning this account metadata.

displayName.description: Display name shown in Admin governance view.

activeModules.description: Bounded list (max 8) of active WargaQu module IDs used on this account.

trahNames.description: Bounded list (max 15) of Trah names joined by this account.

communityNames.description: Bounded list (max 15) of RT/Paguyuban names joined by this account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when account metadata was created.

lastSeenAt.description: Server timestamp of latest login or module activity.

AccountPolicy.title: AccountPolicy
AccountPolicy.description: Admin moderation and VIP Free access override for a specific account.

status.description: Account access status enforced across devices.

freeModules.description: Bounded list (max 6) of monetizable module IDs granted free when allModulesFree is false.

allModulesFree.description: True if all monetizable modules are free for this account.

note.description: Moderation warning or ban reason shown to user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when policy was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when policy was updated.

updatedByUid.description: Admin UID who modified this policy.

GovernanceConfig.title: GovernanceConfig
GovernanceConfig.description: Shared non-PII community free rules (Trah / RT / Paguyuban).

communityFreeRules.description: Bounded list (max 50) of community free modular rules.

updatedByUid.description: Admin UID who updated governance config.

MonetizationConfig.title: MonetizationConfig
MonetizationConfig.description: Shared non-PII modular monetization toggles and fee configuration.

rules.description: Bounded list (max 10) of module monetization rules.

updatedByUid.description: Admin UID who updated monetization config.

AdminMarker.title: AdminMarker
AdminMarker.description: Admin role assignment document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin marker was created.

/accountRegistry/{uid}.description: Lightweight account metadata & module activity per authenticated citizen.

/accountPolicies/{policyId}.description: Per-account moderation & VIP Free policies managed by Admins.

/appConfig/governance.description: Non-PII community free rules (Trah/RT/Paguyuban) managed by Admins.

/appConfig/monetization.description: Non-PII modular monetization settings managed by Admins.
